mapper.insert: insert into ai_video_task_attempt (task_id, attempt_no, status, provider_code, model_code, provider_request_id, provider_task_id, error_code, error_message, started_time, completed_time) values (#{taskId}, #{attemptNo}, #{status}, #{providerCode}, #{modelCode}, #{providerRequestId}, #{providerTaskId}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedTime}, #{completedTime})
mapper.select: select attempt_id, task_id, attempt_no, status, provider_code, model_code, provider_request_id, provider_task_id, error_code, error_message, started_time, completed_time, create_time from ai_video_task_attempt where task_id = #{taskId} order by attempt_no asc
mapper.update: update ai_video_task_attempt set status = 'SUCCEEDED', provider_task_id = coalesce(#{providerTaskId}, provider_task_id), error_code = null, error_message = null, completed_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('SUBMITTED', 'RUNNING') and attempt_no = ( select max(attempt_no) from ( select attempt_no from ai_video_task_attempt where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('SUBMITTED', 'RUNNING') ) active_attempts )

update ai_video_task_attempt set status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('SUBMITTED', 'RUNNING') and attempt_no = ( select max(attempt_no) from ( select attempt_no from ai_video_task_attempt where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('SUBMITTED', 'RUNNING') ) active_attempts )
